title: Hanaoka's surgery under general anaesthesia
summary: Japanese surgeon Hanaoka Seishū removed a breast tumour from a patient under a herbal general anaesthetic.
why: Regarded by some as the first reliably documented surgery under general anaesthesia.

notes.problem: Why says 'first recorded'; source hedges ('said to have been', 'regarded today by some as the first reliable documentation'). Place: he practised in Hirayama, Kii Province (now Wakayama Prefecture), not Wakayama city.
